claude.country: Multinational (four continents; incl. Austria-funded, US ED-BWH cohort)

links.outcome: Worst-group AUROC gap across age, sex, race subgroups for ECG foundation models
links.effect: Median worst-group AUROC gap 0.028 for age vs 0.004 (sex) and 0.016 (race); age exceeded sex in 97% of results; ED-BWH 30-day MACE AUROC 0.81–0.90 under 40 years, 0.64–0.71 at ≥75.
links.quote: Disparities concentrated on age, not sex or race (median worst-group AUROC gap 0.028  vs 0.004 and 0.016; age exceeded sex in 97% of results) and replicated externally (ED-BWH 30-day MACE AUROC 0.81–0.90 under 40 years, 0.64–0.71 at ≥75).

links.outcome: Whether post-hoc correction, more labelled data, comorbidity exclusion, or low-rank fine-tuning closes age disparity
links.effect: No remedy closed the age gap; low-rank adaptation changed the gap by −0.007 to −0.004.
links.quote: No remedy closed it (low-rank adaptation: −0.007 to −0.004).

links.outcome: Performance variation across held-out external cohorts and sites
links.effect: Age-related gap replicated externally across six held-out cohorts; ED-BWH MACE AUROC 0.81–0.90 under 40 vs 0.64–0.71 at ≥75.
links.quote: Disparities concentrated on age, not sex or race (median worst-group AUROC gap 0.028  vs 0.004 and 0.016; age exceeded sex in 97% of results) and replicated externally (ED-BWH 30-day MACE AUROC 0.81–0.90 under 40 years, 0.64–0.71 at ≥75).

links.outcome: Fixed pooled threshold performance by age subgroup masked by headline metric
links.effect: Authors state a threshold fixed on the pooled population operates at a worse point for older patients than the headline metric implies; age-stratified reporting recommended.
links.quote: Fairness evaluation of ECG foundation models should prioritise age and report age-stratified performance as a primary result, because a threshold fixed on the pooled population operates at a worse point for older patients than the headline metric implies.

links.effect: Median worst-group AUROC gap: age 0.028 vs sex 0.004 and race 0.016; ED-BWH MACE AUROC 0.81–0.90 under 40 vs 0.64–0.71 at ≥75.
links.quote: Disparities concentrated on age, not sex or race (median worst-group AUROC gap 0.028  vs 0.004 and 0.016; age exceeded sex in 97% of results) and replicated externally (ED-BWH 30-day MACE AUROC 0.81–0.90 under 40 years, 0.64–0.71 at ≥75).

links.outcome: Age AUROC gap after mitigation attempts
links.effect: No remedy closed the gap; low-rank adaptation changed it by −0.007 to −0.004.
links.quote: No remedy closed it (low-rank adaptation: −0.007 to −0.004).

links.outcome: Foundation models versus untrained and classical baselines
links.effect: Untrained copies r=0.81 over 102 pairs and classical measurements ρ=0.90 reproduced gaps; pretraining raised AUROC +0.067 without changing them.
